content_blocks.code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame([[1, 2]], columns=[" Product ", "Unit Price"])
df.columns = df.columns.str.strip().str.lower().str.replace(" ", "_", regex=False)
print(df.columns.tolist())
